description: This file implements interrupt handling and trigger initialization for the LIS2DS12 accelerometer driver in Zephyr RTOS, including GPIO callbacks, interrupt setup, and trigger configuration.

methods.name: lis2ds12_gpio_callback
methods.description: Handles GPIO interrupt callback, disables interrupt pin and signals thread or work queue.

methods.name: lis2ds12_handle_drdy_int
methods.description: Invokes data ready handler if registered.

methods.name: lis2ds12_handle_int
methods.description: Handles interrupt event, checks source, and re-enables GPIO interrupt.

methods.name: lis2ds12_thread
methods.description: Thread function for handling interrupts in own thread context.

methods.name: lis2ds12_work_cb
methods.description: Workqueue callback for handling interrupts in global thread context.

methods.name: lis2ds12_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes interrupt routing and notification mode.

methods.name: lis2ds12_trigger_init
methods.description: Sets up GPIO interrupt for data ready signals and thread/work setup.

methods.name: lis2ds12_trigger_set
methods.description: Configures trigger and handler for data ready events.
